blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Bradner. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Bradner, Abbotsford: 2 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 50% on only 2 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 9 of 9 Abbotsford communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Bradner was 3 in June and 2 in October, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall, and 3 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 0.5% of Abbotsford’s 410 houses listed.
Bradner home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

5 houses sold in Bradner with a median price of $1,575,000, taking a median of 80 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 40% sold above list. They had a median $828 per square foot, a median year built of 1980 and a median lot of 22,127 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Bradner?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 2 houses listed in Bradner. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Bradner a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Bradner had a sales ratio of 50% on only 2 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Bradner from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in Bradner over those 5 months, out of 287 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Bradner?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Bradner sell for?
faq.a: 5 houses sold in Bradner between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,575,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Bradner?
faq.a: The median was 80 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.0% of the last list price (40% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
